options: A GPS position packet once a second
questions.explain: A message sent once a second by every participant: type, mode, arming state. No heartbeat means no connection.

questions.q: How do you know a command was executed?
questions.explain: MAV_RESULT_ACCEPTED (0) means accepted; anything else is a rejection.
0 is HEARTBEAT, 1 is SYS_STATUS, 30 is ATTITUDE, 33 is GLOBAL_POSITION_INT.

questions.q: Which single command requests only ATTITUDE at 10 Hz?
questions.explain: The interval is in microseconds; a stream-rate parameter (MAV3_EXTRA1) set with PARAM_SET changes a whole group of messages.

options: The port and the baud rate

questions.q: When should you use MAVSDK instead of pymavlink?
options: Only with PX4; ArduPilot is not supported
questions.explain: MAVSDK offers high-level arm()/takeoff() for applications; pymavlink is for learning and anything non-standard.
